TIBETLNG 1: The course is designed to develop reading competence in Classical Tibetan. The emphasis is on vocabulary building, grammar, reading comprehension, and translation of materials pertinent to Tibetan religion, literature, history, and culture.
TIBETLNG 2: Continuation of TIBETLNG 1. The course is designed to develop reading competence in Classical Tibetan. The emphasis is on vocabulary building, grammar, reading comprehension, and translation of materials pertinent to Tibetan religion, literature, history, and culture.
TIBETLNG 3: Continuation of TIBETLNG 2. The course is designed to develop reading competence in Classical Tibetan. The emphasis is on vocabulary building, grammar, reading comprehension, and translation of materials pertinent to Tibetan religion, literature, history, and culture. Fulfills the University Foreign Language Requirement.
